notes: No individual case records can be extracted. The report gives only aggregate figures for the 24 hours to 26 August 2026: 81 new confirmed cases (Ituri 52, Nord-Kivu 22, Haut-Uélé 5, Tshopo 2, Sud-Kivu 0, Bas-Uélé 0), of which 35 were community deaths (Swab+) and 7 were intra-CTE deaths, giving 42 deaths on the day. Confirmed cases therefore rose from the previous total to 5,794 cumulative, with 2,786 deaths. Two new health zones were affected in Nord-Kivu: Biena and Manguredjipa. The 24 recoveries on 26 August (12 Ituri, 11 Haut-Uélé, 1 Nord-Kivu) are given only as counts, with no case identifiers, so they cannot be matched to records under outcome_updates. Cumulative recoveries are 1,293. The contacts_under_follow_up figure of 26,850 is the 'contacts à suivre' figure for the 24-hour period, not an explicit cumulative total. The report gives no cumulative suspected-case total, so suspected_cases is null. The report date is taken from 'Date de rapportage: 26 août 2026' (published 27 August 2026).
